items.title: Jonathan Scales interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 23, 2025
items.q: I’m also inspired by like, you know, Bela Fleck and Chick Corea, and you know Pat Metheny.

ctx.x: I mean you had like this – you know the ostinato starting out, and then these melodies on top of it, it seemed like it connected quite well for me.

Thank you. You know so like I grew up listening to Bach and Mozart. I wanted to do that when I was a kid. I was very fascinated with that. But you know with anything else I think that we take in just things that we like and it gets processed in our brains and then it comes out of ourselves in our own way, just like it does with language. You know like we hear words when we are a baby, we hear words from our friends, we read books, we watch movies, we watch cartoons, we hear people say cuss words and then we hear…
Are you inspired by other artistic genres other than music?
